notes:
Top-level: mid-market PLG SaaS (product-led growth), customer support automation focus. Evaluating Hosted API first with strong interest in moving to Dedicated reserved capacity if latency/cost tradeoffs favorable.

Key ask from CTO: 'we need streaming with tool calling and end-to-end <200ms per-token for interactive agents' — wants benchmark against current in-house infra.

Security: Okta SSO/SAML required, SOC2 Type II in vendor profile mandatory, audit logs + KMS for encryption of customer vectors. Legal asked for 90-day log retention by default and demonstrable PII redaction from any stored request logs.

POC scope (agreed verbally): 4-week hosted POC — streaming chat with tool calling to 3 internal services (billing, knowledgebase, ticket lookup), 50 RPS sustained, 150 concurrent conversations targeted. Deliverables: latency report (p50/p95/p99), cost-per-1k-tokens, evidence of redaction in logs, SAML integration checklist.

Pricing sensitivity: mid; willing to commit to 6-month paid POC if hosted pricing + SLA acceptable. If POC shows reliable latency and cost predictability, will evaluate Dedicated for production traffic and VPC egress controls.

Quotes / points: 'We can't ship if response UI stutters — streaming must be smooth and tool-calls <300ms external service latency budget.'

Internal stakeholders: CTO (final gate), Head of Platform (owns infra eval), Security Ops (SAML + SOC2 review), Legal (data residency), Product (owns success metrics).

Other notes: small pilot already built on open-source LLM locally; main motivator to move to Redwood is operational reliability + pipelines for rollout and fallback routing. Open to Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching/quant) to reduce cost after baseline established.
